concept: A serene and luxurious portrayal of Dove Intense Repair Nourishing Shampoo for damaged hair, emphasizing the bottle and its nourishing benefits.

scenes.visual: A Dove Intense Repair Nourishing Shampoo bottle standing on a wet marble countertop
scenes.background: A wet marble countertop with water droplets, soft morning light from the left, creating a reflective and luminous surface
scenes.vo: Har dhamaal ke baad bhi, apni beauty maintain karni chahiye.

scenes.visual: Close-up view of the Dove Intense Repair Nourishing Shampoo bottle's label
scenes.background: The same wet marble countertop with softer focus on the label area
scenes.vo: Dove ka Intense Repair Nourishing Shampoo, apne hair ko acha se nirmaan karne ke liye.

scenes.visual: A hand pouring Dove Intense Repair Nourishing Shampoo into a basin of water, showing suds
scenes.background: A white basin filled with water, soft diffused lighting, water suds forming around the poured shampoo
scenes.vo: Hair ke damage se protect karne ke liye, Dove Intense Repair Shampoo ka istemal karein.

notes: The ad focuses on the luxurious and effective nature of Dove Intense Repair Nourishing Shampoo, showcasing its ability to nourish and repair damaged hair through elegant shots and minimal text.
